entries.title: Leviticus 18:1
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 18:2
segments: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:3
segments: You shall not do like the doings of the land of Egypt in which you lived. And you shall not do like the doings of the land of Canaan, where I bring you. Neither shall you walk in their ordinances.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:4
segments: You shall do My judgments and keep My ordinances, to walk in them. I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:5
segments: And you shall keep My statutes and My judgments, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:6
segments: None of you shall approach to any who are near of kin to him, to uncover [their] nakedness. I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:7
segments: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father or the nakedness of your mother. She [is] your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:8
segments: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife. It [is] your father's nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:9
segments: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father or the daughter of your mother, born at home or born away. Their nakedness you shall not uncover.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:10
segments: The nakedness of your son's daughter, or of your daughter's daughter, you shall not uncover their nakedness. For theirs [is] your own nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:11
segments: You shall not uncover the nakedness of the daughter of your father's wife, begotten of your father. She [is] your sister.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:12
segments: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's sister. She [is] your father's near kinswoman.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:13
segments: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister. For she [is] your mother's near kinswoman.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:14
segments: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's brother. You shall not approach his wife. She [is] your aunt.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:15
segments: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She [is] your son's wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:16
segments: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother's wife. It [is] your brother's nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:17
segments: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shall you undertake to uncover her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter. They [are] her near kinswomen; it [is] wickedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:18
segments: And you shall not take a wife to her sister, to vex [her], to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:19
segments: Also you shall not approach to a woman to uncover her nakedness in the impurity of her uncleanness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:20
segments: And you shall not lie carnally with your neighbor's wife, to defile yourself with her.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:21
segments: And you shall not let any of your seed pass through [the fire] to Molech, neither shall you profane the name of your God. I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:22
segments: You shall not lie with mankind as with womankind. It [is] abomination [to God].

entries.title: Leviticus 18:23
segments: And you shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. And a woman shall not stand before an animal to lie down to it. It [is] a [shameful] mixing.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:24
segments: Do not defile yourselves in any of these things. For in all these the nations are defiled, which I cast out before you.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:25
segments: And the land is defiled. Therefore I visit its wickedness on it, and the land itself vomits out those who live in it.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:26
segments: You shall therefore keep My statutes and My judgments, and shall not commit [any] of these abominations, [neither] the native, nor any stranger that lives among you.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:27
segments: For the men of the land who [were] before you have done all these abominations, and the land is defiled.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:28
segments: [You shall not do these] so that the land may not spew you out also when you defile it, as it spewed out the nations that [were] before you.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:29
segments: For whoever shall commit [any] of these abominations, even the souls who commit [them] shall be cut off from among their people.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:30
segments: And you shall keep My ordinance, so as not to do [any] of these abominable customs which were committed before you, and that you do not defile yourselves in them. I [am] the LORD your God.
